invention.ref: Momofuku Ando perfected flash-fried instant ramen in a backyard shed in Ikeda, Osaka
invention.ref_zh: 安藤百福在大阪府池田市自家后院小屋发明瞬间油热干燥法，研制出方便面

patent.ref: Japanese manufacturing patent granted to Momofuku Ando (Nissin)
patent.ref_zh: 安藤百福（日清食品）取得即食拉面制造工艺专利

mass_production.ref: Nissin Food Products launched Chikin Ramen in Japan on August 25, 1958
mass_production.ref_zh: 日清食品于 1958 年 8 月 25 日正式发售‘鸡汤拉面’（Chikin Ramen）

popularization.ref: Nissin launched Cup Noodles, transforming instant noodles into a global portable staple
popularization.ref_zh: 日清推出容器装‘杯面’（Cup Noodles），推动方便面走向全球普及

locations.place_label_zh: 日本大阪府池田市（安藤百福发明鸡汤拉面）
locations.place_label_en: Ikeda, Osaka, Japan (Momofuku Ando invents Chikin Ramen)

sources.title: Cup Noodles Museum Osaka Ikeda — The Birth of Chicken Ramen

summary_zh: 1958 年安藤百福在日本池田发明油炸脱水拉面，开水冲泡即可食用；1971 年杯面的问世推动其成为风靡全球的便携日常速食。
summary_en: Invented in 1958 by Momofuku Ando in Ikeda, Japan, flash-fried instant noodles rehydrate rapidly in boiling water. The 1971 launch of Cup Noodles turned it into a global dietary staple.

image.alt_zh: 一碗煮好的方便面配蔬菜与鸡蛋
image.alt_en: A bowl of prepared instant noodles with vegetables and an egg
